model_name: AmpAB100 — 100W Class-AB Linear Audio Power Amplifier
tagline: 100W Linear Class-AB High-Fidelity Audio Power Amplifier with Balanced XLR Input & Optical Peak Telemetry
description: 90.0×75.0 mm 2-layer matte-black ENIG 100W Class-AB audio power amplifier PCB engineered by MAICXEN EDGE. Features a heatsink-backed Multiwatt-15 monolithic Class-AB power stage (U5 + finned extruded heatsink U8), symmetrical dual-rail reservoir capacitors (-Vs / +Vs / GND), balanced 3-pin XLR input stage, hardware MUTE and STANDBY control switches, and a dedicated 10-pin DIP peak/VU LED driver (U6) with precision trim calibration.
key_components: Multiwatt-15 100W Class-AB Power Stage (U5 + U8 Heatsink)
DIP-10 Analog Peak/Level LED Driver (U6 + LED1–LED3)
engineering_note: Low-noise star-ground layout separating the balanced XLR signal front-end and DIP-10 peak detector from the high-current ±Vs reservoir and Speaker output rails.
